plugins.name: emmz
plugins.description: Lean OpenSpec workflow: greenfield discovery, architecture decisions, a Makefile gate surface plus a CLAUDE.md build loop (no subagents, no hooks), a timestamped devlog folder per change, a migration off dmons, a /clear-pickup command and tool, and a context-usage meter that nudges past 40% and 50%.
